rubric.role_summary: Scientific communication and claims strategy role for personalized hair and skin care, translating research and product testing into substantiated content and coordinating across R&D, brand, and product teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Scientific communication and claims strategy role for personalized hair and skin care, translating research and product testing into substantiated content and coordinating across R&D, brand, and product teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Scientific or technical background in cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in scientific communication, claims substantiation, or R&D–marketing liaison roles.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry.
- French language skills.
- Project management skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): Greater Paris area. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Hybrid work is based in one of these areas.

must_haves.requirement: Scientific or technical background in cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or a related field.
must_haves.source_quote: Strong scientific/technical background (cosmetic science, dermatology, biology, or related field)

must_haves.source_quote: 5 to 10 years of experience in scientific communication, claims substantiation, or R&D-marketing liaison roles

preferences.requirement: Experience in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry.
preferences.source_quote: ideally in beauty/cosmetics or a related regulated industry
French a plus, given cross-team collaboration

location.requirement_text: Location: Greater Paris area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Ability to move between deep science and brand storytelling.
Appetite for AI tools and agentic AI, and curiosity about AI-amplified projects.
Excellent communication quality beyond English-language proficiency.
Creative thinking and a willingness to challenge the status quo.
Comfort with both strategic and hands-on work, flexibility, and adaptability.
Teamwork and ability to build trust across scientific and non-scientific stakeholders.
